preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers t (number of queries) and n (order of the graph), where 1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5 and 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= 10**16 and 1 <= int(b) <= 10**16 and int(a) != int(b) for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two integers ai and bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ 10^16, ai ≠ bi), representing vertex pairs in the graph D(n).

preconditions.expression: all(int(a) <= |D(n)| and int(b) <= |D(n)| for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: All vertex numbers in queries are valid for the graph D(n), i.e., ai, bi ≤ |D(n)|.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == 1 and output_line.strip().isdigit() for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of the output is a single non-negative integer representing the shortest path length between the queried vertices.
The shortest path length between any two distinct vertices is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line) == shortest_path_length(ai, bi, n) for (ai, bi), output_line in zip(queries, stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each query (ai, bi), the output line is the shortest path length between vertices ai and bi in the graph D(n).
